About the Course

Levels Language Academy offers specialized preparation for international Cambridge examinations FCE, CAE, and PET. The program is designed to equip learners with the skills, strategies, and confidence necessary to achieve excellent results and obtain internationally recognized certification.

Instruction is delivered by highly qualified Georgian and foreign teachers, all certified by Cambridge University with CELTA credentials. Students benefit from professional guidance across all exam components and gain the essential competencies required for success.
What will students learn in this course?
Targeted preparation for all exam components: Reading, Writing, Speaking, Listening, and Grammar.
Development of exam-specific strategies and practical test-taking skills.
Improvement in academic vocabulary, accuracy, and communication.
Regular practice tests and feedback to monitor progress.
What learning materials will be used?
Official Cambridge examination preparation resources.
Practice tests, exercises, and supplementary materials tailored to student level and exam requirements.
When does the course start?
Enrollment is open on a continuous basis.
A placement test and interview are conducted before registration to determine student level and design an appropriate program.
How are groups formed?
Students are grouped based on language proficiency and test results.
Grouping ensures learners receive the right level of support and challenge.
Groups are also organized according to the age of students, ensuring that learners study alongside peers with similar needs and learning dynamics.
What is the lesson structure?
Lessons are fully focused on exam preparation.
Students take several simulated exams during the course to experience real test conditions and measure progress.
Personalized feedback ensures steady improvement in weaker areas.
